info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update It Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The IT Management Update API allows clients to modify the details of IT management systems administration by providing a specific parameter. This enables businesses to adapt their IT management strategies in response to changing operational needs. Primary resources include system configurations and settings that facilitate administration updates. Common consumers of this API include IT administrators and system operators who require efficient control of system parameters for enhanced governance. Utilize this API to ensure that your IT environment remains in sync with evolving business requirements.

patch.description: This endpoint allows for the modification of the specified system administration resource identified by the resource ID RES-100045. Users can update relevant details and configurations as required.
